import sys
from pathlib import Path

# The Python equivalent of here::here(): find the repo root by its _quarto.yml,
# then put python/ on the import path so the shared helpers resolve from any
# working directory. The downloadable script gets the same line written in for it
# by tools/extract-code.py, where there is no _quarto.yml, hence the None case.
root = next((p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / "_quarto.yml").exists()), None)
if root is not None:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "python"))
